name: ⚡️🌌Teleporter Simulator🌌⚡️
desc:
⚡️🌌 Teleporter Simulator 🌌⚡️

In this game the possibility is endless. The only limit is yourself. Train to break though all limitations & become The Strongest Jumper!!! 💪

💥 Select "Teleport" & Click anywhere on the screen to begin teleporting
🔥 Use "Train" to train and gain Jumper Power
🚀 The more you train the farther you can teleport
💨 Teleport yourself to anywhere you wish
🔮 Collect Time Spheres for multipliers
🗼 Teleport onto Buildings & Skyscrapers to find special Hidden Time Spheres
😈 Kill other innocent Jumpers to prevent them from obtaining time spheres & become a Bad Jumper
😇 Protect the good from harm’s way - Kill all that is bad & become a Good Jumper
🌎 Teleport to different islands to continue your training

⚠️ If you come across an exploiter or glitches please report them directly in our Community Server⚠️
